title: Draft queue embargo badge and quick unpublish
context: Repo: inkwell-cms, the newsroom CMS used by desk editors. The app ships light and dark themes via CSS custom properties in tokens.css; light is the default. WCAG 2.1 AA conformance is a release requirement, and several editors work keyboard-only or with screen readers.

defects.description: The unpublish control is a span with an onClick and an aria-hidden icon: not focusable, not operable by keyboard, and no accessible name, so keyboard and screen-reader editors cannot use it. Should be a button with an aria-label.
Badge text is hard-coded #ffffff on background var(--surface), which is #ffffff in the default light theme (tokens.css), so the embargo text is invisible for most users; only legible in dark mode.

decoys: Unpublish is a one-click destructive action on the row, but it is gated by the shared confirm dialog with destructive: true before onUnpublish runs, and stopPropagation prevents it opening the draft.
